MATCH (p:Person)-[:WORKS_AT]->(c:Company)
WITH p, c
ORDER BY p.age DESC
LIMIT 2
CALL {
  WITH p, c
  MATCH (p)-[r:WORKS_AT]->(c)
  WHERE p.age > 25
  RETURN COALESCE(r, null) AS rel
}
WITH p, COUNT(rel) AS works_count
ORDER BY works_count DESC
LIMIT 3
RETURN p.name, works_count;
CYPHER x=1 RETURN 1 AS x;

UNWIND [{name:'Alice'}, {name:'Bob'}] AS person
WITH person.name AS wanted, person AS p
MATCH (p:Person)
WHERE p.name = wanted
RETURN p.name AS name

CREATE (n:Person {name: 'Alice', age: 30})
DELETE n
RETURN n.name AS name

CYPHER 25
UNWIND [30,20] AS age
RETURN age
NEXT
WHEN age >= 25 THEN
  RETURN {v:age} AS a
ELSE
  RETURN [age] AS a
NEXT
FILTER a IS :: LIST<INTEGER>
RETURN size(a) AS s;

CYPHER 25
RETURN 1 AS y
NEXT
RETURN 1 AS y
UNION
FILTER false
UNWIND [] AS z
RETURN z AS y;

CYPHER 25
MATCH (n)
LET x = 1
MATCH (n:_C25Fuzz)
USING SCAN n:_C25Fuzz
RETURN 1;

CYPHER 25
WITH 1 AS x
MATCH SHORTEST 1 (n:N {case: 'arraycopy', id: 1})-[:R]->(m:N {case: 'arraycopy', id: 2})
WHERE COUNT { RETURN x } = 1 AND (COUNT { RETURN x } % -0.0) IS NOT :: STRING
RETURN n;

CYPHER 25
MATCH p = (n:N {case: 'slot'})-[:R]->(n:N)
CALL (n, p) {
  FILTER true
  SKIP 1
  FOR f IN [0, 2, -1]
  UNWIND ['x', n.name] AS u
  WITH n AS n, f AS f
  OFFSET 1
  FOR g IN [true]
  SKIP 0
  RETURN ALL f AS sq OFFSET 0
}
LET v = length(p)
RETURN sq AS out0;

MATCH (n:N) DETACH DELETE n;

CREATE (a:N {id: 1}),
       (x:N {id: 2}),
       (y:N {id: 3}),
       (x)-[:R]->(a),
       (a)-[:R]->(y);

CYPHER 25
MATCH (n:N {id: 1})
RETURN n AS a
NEXT
RETURN 1 AS s
UNION
MATCH ANY SHORTEST (x:N {id: 2})-[:R]-(a)-[:R]-(y:N {id: 3})
RETURN 2 AS s;

MATCH (n:N) DETACH DELETE n;

MATCH (person:Person)
WHERE EXISTS {
  MATCH (person)-[:LIVING_IN*1..2]->(:Country {name: 'Germany'})
  UNION
  MATCH (person)-[:WORKING_IN]->(:Country {name: 'United Kingdom'})
}
OPTIONAL MATCH (person)-[r:LIVING_IN]->(c:Country)
WITH person, collect({rel: r, country: c}) AS connections
RETURN person.name AS name, size(connections) AS connection_count
ORDER BY name DESC
LIMIT 10

MATCH (p:Person)
WHERE EXISTS { MATCH (p)-[:LIVING_IN]->(c:Country) RETURN c.name }
WITH COLLECT(p) AS people
OPTIONAL MATCH path = (p2:Person)-[:LIVING_IN]->(c2:Country)-[:HAS_CAPITAL]->(ci:City)
WITH people, COLLECT(path) AS paths
RETURN CASE WHEN size(paths) > 0 THEN 'Paths found' ELSE 'No paths' END AS status,
       [person IN people | person.name] AS person_names
ORDER BY status DESC
LIMIT 5

MATCH (employee:Person)
OPTIONAL MATCH (employee)-[r:WORKS_FOR]->(company)
WHERE r.since > 2020
WITH employee, collect({companyName: company.name, sinceYear: r.since}) AS workHistory
WHERE size(workHistory) > 0
RETURN employee.name AS name, COUNT { (employee)-[:WORKS_FOR]->() } AS jobCount, workHistory
ORDER BY jobCount DESC

MATCH (p:Person)
WITH p ORDER BY p.age DESC LIMIT 2
CREATE (new:City {name: 'Metropolis'})
WITH collect(p) AS people, new
MATCH (c:City)
WHERE c.name = new.name
RETURN c.name AS city, count(people) AS resident_count, people

SELECT * FROM cypher('fuzz_graph', $$
  MATCH (a:Person)
  WITH a LIMIT 1
  CREATE (new:Person {name:'Nia'})
  CREATE (a)-[:FRIEND]->(new)
  RETURN a.name AS a_name
$$) AS (a_name agtype);

SELECT * FROM cypher('fuzz_graph', $$
  MATCH (p:Person)
  OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[:FRIEND]->(f)
  WHERE COUNT { MATCH (p)-[:FRIEND*..2]->(x) RETURN x } > 1
  RETURN p.name AS person, f.name AS friend
  ORDER BY person, friend
$$) AS (person agtype, friend agtype);

SELECT * FROM cypher('fuzz_graph', $$
  MATCH (n:Person)
  RETURN n AS person
  ORDER BY person.name DESC
  LIMIT 2
$$) AS (person agtype);

MATCH (person:Person)
WHERE COUNT { (person)-[:HAS_DOG]->(dog:Dog) WHERE person.age > dog.name } > 0
OPTIONAL MATCH (person)-[:HAS_DOG]->(dog:Dog)
RETURN DISTINCT person.name AS name, collect(dog.name) AS dogNames
ORDER BY name
LIMIT 2

SELECT * FROM cypher('fuzz_graph', $$
  UNWIND [1,null,2] AS x
  RETURN sum(x) AS v
$$) AS (v agtype);

MATCH (a)-[r:KNOWS]->(c)
WHERE a.name CONTAINS 'Ali'
SET r.since = '2021'
WITH a, c, r
UNWIND null AS x
RETURN a, c, r.since

MATCH (p:Person)
WHERE p.age > 25
OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[:FRIEND*0..1]-(f:Person)
WITH p, collect(f.name) AS friends
LIMIT 2
RETURN p.name AS person, friends
UNION ALL
MATCH (p:Person)
WHERE p.age <= 25
WITH p LIMIT 2
RETURN p.name AS person, [] AS friends

CREATE (:Person {name:'Alice', age:30}),
       (:Person {name:'Bob', age:25}),
       (:Person {name:'Charlie', age:35});

MATCH (c:Person)
WHERE c.age > 30
WITH collect(c) AS older_people
CREATE (new:Person {name:'David', age: older_people[0].age})
RETURN new.name AS name, new.age AS age;

CREATE (p1:Person {name:'Alice', age:30, nationality:'Canadian'}),
       (p2:Person {name:'Bob', age:25, nationality:'American'}),
       (p3:Person {name:'Charlie', age:35, nationality:'British'}),
       (p4:Person {name:'David', age:40, nationality:'Canadian'}),
       (p5:Person {name:'Eve', age:28, nationality:'American'});

MATCH (p:Person)
WHERE p.nationality IS NOT NULL
RETURN p.nationality AS country, MAX(p.age) AS maxAge
ORDER BY maxAge
UNION ALL
MATCH (p:Person)
WHERE p.nationality IS NULL
RETURN 'Unknown' AS country, MAX(p.age) AS maxAge
ORDER BY maxAge;

CREATE (:Person {name:'Alice', age:30})
RETURN 'created' AS phase, 1 AS v
UNION ALL
MATCH (m:Person)
WHERE m.age > 25
RETURN 'matched' AS phase, count(m) AS v;

WITH 1 AS x
CALL db.labels() YIELD label
RETURN x, label
LIMIT 3;

MATCH (a:Person {name:'Alice'})-[r:KNOWS]->(b:Person)
WITH a, collect(r) AS rels
MATCH path = (a)-[:KNOWS*1..2]->(c:Person)
RETURN length(path) AS len, size(rels) AS relationCount
ORDER BY len;

MATCH (p:Person {name:'Alice'})
MERGE (p)-[r:WORKS_AT {since: 2020}]->(c:Company)
WITH c
MATCH (company:Company)
RETURN c.name AS merged_company_name,
       c.industry AS merged_industry,
       count(company) AS total_companies;

MATCH (a:Person {name:'Alice'})-[r:KNOWS]->(b:Person {name:'Bob'})
WITH a, b, r
MATCH path = (a)-[:KNOWS*]->(b)
RETURN count(r) AS rc;

MATCH (n:Person {name:'Alice'})
WITH n
MATCH (m:Person {name:'Alice'})
SET n.age = 35
RETURN n, m;

MATCH (p:Person {name:'Alice'}), (c:Company {name:'TechCorp'})
UNWIND [1, 2, 3] AS i
SET p.age = p.age + i,
    c.founded = c.founded - i;

MATCH (n:Person)
MATCH (m:Person)
WHERE n.age > m.age
SET n:Employee:Checked
RETURN n.name AS name
ORDER BY name;
RETURN date().year AS y;

MATCH (n:Person)
WITH n, 1 AS x
CREATE (:Temp {x:3})
RETURN n.name AS name, x
ORDER BY name;
RETURN allReduce(acc = 0, x IN [1, 2, 3] | acc + x, x > 0) AS result;

CREATE (:Person {id: 1, name:'Alice', age:30}),
       (:City {name:'New York'}),
       (:Country {name:'USA'});

MATCH (a:Person {id: 1}),
      (c:City {name:'New York'}),
      (u:Country {name:'USA'})
CREATE (a)-[:KNOWS]->(c),
       (c)-[:LOCATED_IN]->(u);
RETURN 'Alice\Bob' AS name;

WITH 1 AS x
CALL db.labels() YIELD label
RETURN x, label
ORDER BY label
LIMIT 5;

WITH [] AS list
CALL {
  WITH list
  WITH list
  WHERE SIZE(list) > 0
  RETURN 1 AS result
  UNION
  WITH list
  WITH list
  WHERE SIZE(list) = 0
  RETURN 0 AS result
}
RETURN result;

MATCH (a:ChainPerson)-[:KNOWS]-(b:ChainPerson)-[:KNOWS]-(c:ChainPerson)
WHERE a.age > 25
WITH a.name AS person_name, COUNT(b) AS connection_count
WHERE connection_count > 0
RETURN person_name, connection_count
ORDER BY person_name;

CREATE (:Person {name:'Alice'}),
       (:Person {name:'Bob'}),
       (:Person {name:'Charlie'});

MATCH (a:Person {name:'Alice'}),
      (b:Person {name:'Bob'}),
      (c:Person {name:'Charlie'})
CREATE (a)-[:KNOWS]->(b),
       (b)-[:KNOWS]->(c),
       (c)-[:KNOWS]->(a);
RETURN [] + 'Alice' + 'Charlie' + '1' AS r;

MATCH (n)
RETURN exists { RETURN n AS x } AS result
ORDER BY result
LIMIT 1;

MATCH (p:GroupPerson)
WITH p, collect(p.name)[0] AS first_name
RETURN p.name AS name, first_name
ORDER BY name;
RETURN [1, duration({months: 1000000})] AS x;

MATCH (p:Person {name:'Alice'})
OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[:HAS_FRIEND]->(f:Person)
WITH p, collect(f) AS friends
RETURN p AS person,
       p.scores[toInteger(avg(size(friends)))] AS selectedScore;
RETURN log10(0) AS x;

MATCH (p:Person {city:'New York'})
OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[:LIVES_IN]->(c:City)
WITH p, c
MATCH (c:City {population:8000000})
RETURN p.name AS p, c.name AS c;

MATCH (n:Person)
WITH *, n AS m
MATCH (m:Person)
RETURN n.name AS n1, m.name AS m1
ORDER BY n1, m1;

MERGE (p:Traveler {name:'Alice'})
WITH p
UNWIND [1, 2, 3] AS i
MERGE (p)-[:VISITS]->(c:Town {name:'London'})
ON MATCH SET c.population = 9000000
RETURN i, c.population AS population
ORDER BY i;

MATCH (p:MergeStart {name:'Alice'})
MERGE (p)-[:WORKS_AT]->(c:MergeCompany {industry:'Technology'})
WITH c
MATCH (x:MergeCompany)
RETURN c.name AS merged_name,
       c.industry AS merged_industry,
       count(x) AS total_companies;

MATCH (p:MergeP)
WITH p, p.score / 2.0 AS halfScore
MERGE (p)-[:FRIEND]->(f:MergeF {name:''})
ON CREATE SET f.score = halfScore + 5.0
RETURN p.name AS person_name, f.score AS friend_score
ORDER BY person_name;

CREATE (a:Person {name: 'Alice', age: 30}),
       (b:Person {name: 'Bob', age: 25}),
       (c:Person {name: 'Charlie', age: 35}),
       (a)-[:KNOWS {since: 2020}]->(b),
       (b)-[:KNOWS {since: 2019}]->(c),
       (a)-[:KNOWS {since: 2021}]->(c);

MATCH (p:Person)
RETURN p.name AS name,
       reduce(total = 0, n IN collect(p.age) | total + n) AS total_age_sum
ORDER BY name;

MATCH (n:Person)--(m:Person)
WITH *
WHERE (n)--(m)
MATCH (p:Person)-[r:KNOWS]-()
WITH *
WHERE (p)-[r:KNOWS]->()<-[r:KNOWS]-()
RETURN count(*) AS cnt;

UNWIND [1, 2, 3] AS x
MATCH (n:Person)
RETURN DISTINCT *, x AS y
ORDER BY y;

MATCH (n0:Person {name:'Alice'})
RETURN stDev(n0.age) AS s, stDevP(n0.age) AS sp;

UNWIND [1, 2, 3, 4, 5] AS x
RETURN sum(CASE WHEN x > 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sum_gt2;

MATCH (n:Person)-[r]->(m:Person)
WHERE ()--()
WITH n, m, r
SKIP 0
CALL { RETURN 1 AS dummy }
RETURN n.name, m.name, type(r)
ORDER BY n.name;

MATCH (n:Person)
WITH collect(n.name) AS names
UNWIND names AS name
RETURN name;

MATCH (p1:Person) WHERE p1.age > 25
MATCH (p2:Person) WHERE p2.age < 30
RETURN p1.name AS person1,
       p2.name AS person2,
       [(p1)-[:KNOWS*1..3]->(p2) | p1.name] AS pathNames;

MATCH (a:Thing)
WHERE all(item IN [1, 2, 3] WHERE item IN a.tags)
RETURN a.name AS name
ORDER BY name;

MATCH (n:Person)
WHERE n.name IN ['Alice', 'Bob'] AND n.age > 20
WITH n
WHERE single(x IN [n.age] WHERE x > 25)
RETURN n.name AS name;

OPTIONAL MATCH p0 = (n0)
RETURN n0, relationships(p0) AS rels;

RETURN duration({days: 2}) > duration({days: 1}) AS gt,
       duration({days: 2}) = duration({days: 2}) AS eq;

MATCH (a:Node {id: 1})
OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[:KNOWS]->(b:Node {id: 2})
WITH a, b
MERGE (a)-[:KNOWS]->(b)
RETURN a.id AS aid, b.id AS bid;

MATCH (n:Person)
WHERE id(n) >= 0
RETURN n.name AS name
ORDER BY name;

MATCH (p:Person)
RETURN p {.name, upperName: toUpper(p.name)} AS proj;

CREATE (a:Node {name:'A'})-[:REL]->(b:Node {name:'B'})-[:REL]->(c:Node {name:'C'});

MATCH p = ()-[*]->()
WITH p, relationships(p) AS rels
FOREACH (r IN reverse(rels) | DELETE endNode(r) DELETE r)
WITH count(*) AS cnt
OPTIONAL MATCH (n:Node)
WHERE NOT (n)--()
RETURN n.name AS orphan, cnt AS deleted_count
ORDER BY orphan;

WITH null AS xs
RETURN reduce(s = 0, x IN xs | s + x) AS total;

WITH 'Bob' AS fName
MATCH (p:Person)-[:FRIEND]->(:Person {name: fName})
RETURN p.name AS person
ORDER BY person;

MATCH (:Person)-[r:KNOWS]->(:Person)
RETURN r.since AS since, r.weight AS weight;

MATCH (p:Person)
RETURN DISTINCT *;

MATCH p = allShortestPaths((:Person)-[:R1|R2*]->(:City))
RETURN size(nodes(p)) AS pathLen;

MATCH (p:Person)
RETURN p.name AS person,
       COLLECT { MATCH (p)-[:KNOWS]->(f:Person) RETURN f.name } AS friendNames
ORDER BY person;

MATCH (person:Person)
RETURN person.name AS name,
       COUNT { (p:Person {name: person.name})-[:OWNS]->(:Dog) } AS dogCount
ORDER BY name;

MATCH (person:Person)
RETURN person.name AS name,
       COUNT { (person)-[:HAS_DOG]->(dog:Dog) WHERE dog.breed = 'Labrador' } AS labCount
ORDER BY labCount DESC;

MATCH (p:Person)
RETURN p.name AS person,
       EXISTS { MATCH (p)-[:WORKS_WITH]->(:Person) } AS worksWith
ORDER BY person;

MATCH (a:Person)-[r:KNOWS WHERE r.since < 2019]-(b)
WHERE NOT (b:NonexistentLabel)
RETURN DISTINCT a.name AS person, b.name AS friend, r.since AS knowsSince
ORDER BY knowsSince;

MATCH (o:Order)
ORDER BY o.orderDate DESC
LIMIT 1
MATCH (o)-[:CONTAINS]->(i:Item)
RETURN o.id AS orderId, collect(i.name) AS items;

MATCH (p:Person)
WITH [i IN collect(p.age) | i * 2] AS ids
MATCH (p2:Person)
WITH *, any(i IN ids WHERE i = p2.age) AS exists
WHERE exists
RETURN p2.name AS name
ORDER BY name;

MATCH (p:Person)
WHERE (p)-[:LIVING_IN]->(:Country {name: 'Germany'})
WITH p
MATCH (p)-[:LIVING_IN]->(c:Country)
RETURN c.name AS country, count(*) AS cnt
ORDER BY country;

MATCH (p:Person)
WITH p.name AS personName
WHERE personName <> 'Bob'
UNWIND range(1, 3) AS i
RETURN personName, i
ORDER BY personName, i;

MATCH (p:Person)
WITH p
LIMIT 2
CALL {
  WITH p
  DELETE p
  RETURN count(*) AS deletedCount
}
WITH deletedCount
OPTIONAL MATCH (q:Person)
WHERE q.age > 30
RETURN deletedCount, count(q) AS olderCount;

MATCH (n) DETACH DELETE n;
CREATE (a:Person {name:'Alice'}),
       (b:Person {name:'Bob'}),
       (c:Person {name:'Charlie'}),
       (a)-[:KNOWS]->(b),
       (b)-[:KNOWS]->(c);

MATCH p = (a)--(b)--(c)
OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[r]->(d)
DELETE r
WITH a, b, c, count(d) AS cnt
OPTIONAL MATCH (e:Person)
RETURN a.name AS a, b.name AS b, c.name AS c, cnt, count(e) AS total
ORDER BY a, b, c;

MATCH path = (p1:Person)-[:KNOWS*0..2]->(p2:Person)
WHERE p1.name='Alice' AND p2.name='Bob'
CREATE (p1)-[:CONNECTED_TO {strength: length(path)}]->(p2)
RETURN p1.name AS source_name, p2.name AS target_name, length(path) AS path_length;

CREATE (:Person {name:'Alice'}), (:Person {name:'Bob'}), (:Person {name:'Charlie'})

MATCH (p:Person)
WITH p, p.name AS name
ORDER BY name
WITH collect(p) AS persons
UNWIND persons AS p1
UNWIND persons AS p2
WITH p1, p2
WHERE p1 <> p2
CREATE (p1)-[:KNOWS]->(p2)
WITH p1, p2
MATCH (p1)-[r:KNOWS]->(p2)
RETURN p1.name, p2.name, count(r) AS cnt
ORDER BY p1.name, p2.name;

CREATE (p:Person {name:'Alice'}),
       (:Company {name:'TechCorp'}),
       (:Company {name:'DataInc'}),
       (:Company {name:'CloudSys'});

UNWIND range(1, 3) AS i
CREATE (n:Node {id: i})
WITH n, i
MATCH (p:Person {name:'Alice'})
MATCH (c:Company)
WHERE c.name IN ['TechCorp','DataInc','CloudSys']
CREATE (p)-[:WORKS_AT {since: i}]->(c)
WITH p, COUNT(p) AS total_works
ORDER BY total_works DESC
LIMIT 1
MATCH (p)-[r:WORKS_AT]->(c)
DELETE r
RETURN p.name AS name, total_works;

CREATE (:Person {name: 'Alice O\'Connor', age: 30});

MATCH (p:Person)
WHERE p.name = 'Alice O\'Connor'
WITH p
UNWIND [p] AS unwound_p
DELETE p
SET p.age = 40
RETURN unwound_p, p
LIMIT 1;

CREATE (a:Person {name:'Alice'}),
       (b:Person {name:'Bob'}),
       (c:Person {name:'Charlie'}),
       (a)-[:KNOWS {step: 1}]->(b),
       (b)-[:KNOWS {step: 2}]->(c),
       (c)-[:KNOWS {step: 3}]->(a);

MATCH path = (:Person {name:'Alice'})-[:KNOWS*3..3]->(:Person {name:'Alice'})
RETURN [n IN nodes(path) | n.name] AS pathNames,
       [rel IN relationships(path) | rel.step] AS stepOrder;

MATCH (p1:Person), (p2:Person)
WHERE p1.name = 'Alice' AND p2.name = 'Bob'
CREATE (p1)-[:FRIEND]->(p2)
WITH p1, p2
MATCH (p1), (p2)
CREATE (p1)-[:WORKS_WITH]->(p2)
WITH p1, p2
ORDER BY p1.age DESC
UNWIND [p1, p2] AS person
MERGE (person)-[:KNOWS]->(person)
RETURN person.name, person.age
ORDER BY person.age;

CREATE (p:Person {name: 'Alice', age: 30}),
       (c:City {name: 'London', population: 8900000}),
       (p)-[:LIVES_IN]->(c);

MATCH (n)
WITH n
OPTIONAL MATCH (n)-[r]->(m), (n)<-[s]-(o)
RETURN n.name AS n_name,
       r IS NULL AS r_null,
       m.name AS m_name,
       s IS NULL AS s_null,
       o.name AS o_name
ORDER BY n_name;

UNWIND range(1, 5) AS i
CREATE (n:Person {id: i})
WITH collect(n) AS batchNodes
MATCH (p:Person)
WHERE any(name IN ['Alice', 'Bob'] WHERE p.name = name)
MERGE (p)-[:KNOWS]->(new:Person {name:'NewFriend'})
WITH p, new
ORDER BY CASE WHEN p.age > 30 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END
RETURN p, new;

UNWIND [1, 2, 3] AS i
CALL {
  WITH i
  MATCH (p:Person)
  WHERE p.age > 25
  RETURN p.name AS personName, p.age AS personAge
}
WITH personName, personAge, i
MATCH (c:Company)
WHERE c.industry = 'Technology'
MERGE (p:Person {name: personName})-[r:WORKS_AT]->(c)
RETURN personName,
       personAge,
       c.name AS companyName,
       COUNT(r) AS relationshipCount
ORDER BY personName DESC
LIMIT 5;

MATCH (p:Person)
WHERE p.active = true
OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[r:LIVES_IN]->(c:City)
WITH p, r, c
SET r.visited = [2021, 2022, 2023]
RETURN p.name AS personName, c.name AS cityName, r.since AS sinceYear
ORDER BY personName;

MERGE (p:Person {name: 'Alice'})
MERGE (c:Company {name: 'TechCorp'})
MERGE (p)-[r:WORKS_AT]->(c)
SET r.since = 2020
RETURN p.name AS personName, c.name AS companyName, r.since AS since
UNION
MATCH (p:Person {name: 'Alice'})
OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[r:WORKS_AT]->(c)
RETURN p.name AS personName, c.name AS companyName, r.since AS since;

CREATE (:Person {name:'Alice', age:30})-[:KNOWS {since:2020}]->(:Person {name:'Bob', age:25});

MATCH (n:Person)
WHERE n.age > 20
WITH n
WHERE ()<-[:KNOWS {since: 2020}]-()
RETURN n.name AS name
ORDER BY n.name;

MATCH (n) DETACH DELETE n;
CREATE (a {name: 'Alice', tags: ['dev', 'ops']}),
       (b {name: 'Bob', tags: ['dev']}),
       (c {name: 'Charlie', tags: ['ops']}),
       (a)-[:KNOWS]->(b),
       (a)-[:KNOWS]->(c);

MATCH ()-[r]->()
WITH r
MATCH (x)-[r]->(y)
WHERE x.name CONTAINS 'A' AND y.name CONTAINS 'B'
RETURN x.name AS x, y.name AS y
ORDER BY x, y;

MATCH (n) DETACH DELETE n;
CREATE (:Person {name:'Alice', age:30}), (:Person {name:'Bob', age:25});

CREATE p = (a:Person {name: 'Alice'})-[r:KNOWS]->(b:Person {name: 'Bob'})
RETURN p;

MATCH (n) DETACH DELETE n;

CREATE ()-[x:KNOWS]->()
DELETE x
MERGE ()-[s:FRIEND]->()
ON CREATE SET x.since = 2020
WITH *
MATCH ()-[r]->()
RETURN type(r) AS t, r.since AS since
ORDER BY t;

CREATE (:Person {name:'Alice', duration: duration('P2Y')}),
       (:City {name:'London', population: 8900000});

MATCH (p:Person {name: 'Alice'})
MATCH (c:City)
WHERE p.duration > duration('P1Y') AND c.population > 5000000
RETURN p.name AS person_name,
       c.name AS city_name,
       p.duration AS person_duration,
       c.population AS city_population
ORDER BY city_population DESC
LIMIT 2;

MATCH (p:Person)-[:WORKS_FOR]->(c:Company)
WHERE p.age > 25
  AND c.revenue / 1000.0 IN [50.0, 100.0, 150.0]
WITH p, c, p.salary / 12.0 AS monthlySalary
WHERE monthlySalary > 3000.0
RETURN p.name AS personName, c.name AS companyName, monthlySalary;

CREATE (a:Person {name: 'Alice'}),
       (b:Person {name: 'Bob'}),
       (c:Person {name: 'Charlie'}),
       (d:Person {name: 'Diana'}),
       (a)-[:KNOWS]->(b),
       (b)-[:KNOWS]->(c),
       (c)-[:KNOWS]->(d),
       (a)-[:KNOWS]->(c);

MATCH (s:Person {name:'Alice'}), (t:Person {name:'Diana'})
WITH s, t
MATCH p = (s)-[*3]->(t)
RETURN [x IN nodes(p) | x.name] AS names
ORDER BY length(p) DESC;

CREATE (:Person {name: 'Alice', age: 30}), (:Person {name: 'Bob', age: 25})
WITH count(*) AS dummy
MATCH (n:Person) WHERE n.age > 25
RETURN n.name AS name
UNION
MATCH (n:Person) WHERE n.age <= 25
RETURN n.name AS name;

CREATE (a:Person {name:'Alice', age:30}),
